explication: Chucker is an Android HTTP(S) inspection tool: an OkHttp interceptor captures traffic, persists transaction records, and presents them in an in-app activity for browsing, filtering, and inspecting details. Users can search payload text, view response images, decode bodies with custom decoders, and export/share transactions as text or HAR. Retention and notification behavior are configurable. The graph emphasizes documented product stages and sampled repository/UI wiring; several capture and notification internals were not excerpted, so their connections are limited to README evidence.
